targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(m.value_num) AS kwh FROM metric m WHERE m.configuration_id = (SELECT id FROM configuration WHERE module = 'POWER' AND name = 'electricity_consumption') AND m.recorded_at >= date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Vienna')

SELECT sum(m.value_num) * ${kwh_price} AS cost FROM metric m WHERE m.configuration_id = (SELECT id FROM configuration WHERE module = 'POWER' AND name = 'electricity_consumption') AND m.recorded_at >= date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Vienna')

panels.title: Consumption and cost per day / month
panels.description: One row per day; switches to one row per month when the time range is longer than 62 days.

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '62 days' THEN 'month' ELSE 'day' END AS unit) SELECT to_char(date_trunc(p.unit, m.recorded_at, 'Europe/Vienna') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Vienna', CASE p.unit WHEN 'month' THEN 'YYYY-MM' ELSE 'YYYY-MM-DD' END) AS "Period", sum(m.value_num) AS "Consumption (kWh)", sum(m.value_num) * ${kwh_price} AS "Cost (EUR)" FROM metric m, p WHERE m.configuration_id = (SELECT id FROM configuration WHERE module = 'POWER' AND name = 'electricity_consumption') AND m.recorded_at >= date_trunc(p.unit, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Europe/Vienna') AND m.recorded_at <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT m.recorded_at AS time, m.value_num AS "kWh" FROM metric m JOIN configuration c ON c.id = m.configuration_id WHERE c.name = 'electricity_consumption' AND $__timeFilter(m.recorded_at) ORDER BY m.recorded_at
